basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old craft beer enthusiast hailing from Ann Arbor, Michigan. I work as a freelance writer focusing on technology and lifestyle subjects. I spend my weekends exploring local breweries and indulging in my passion for historical research, particularly lost media. I’m married to a fellow Redditor who shares my love for gaming, especially Red Dead Redemption on PC. My typical online hours are late evenings, usually after 9 PM, when I can unwind and catch up on my favorite subreddits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Communications and have honed my writing skills through a decade of freelance work. My expertise spans craft beer brewing and digital technology, influenced by both formal education and extensive self-study. My interest in lost media started as a hobby but has become a secondary niche in my writing career.
